description: All 16 runs of the predeclared 100k-key, 1KiB-value snapshot output comparison: A is frozen d2d5eb8 Engine and B is frozen bfeddf1 buffered Engine; both use identical frozen 7d29382 Gateway and Benchmark. ABBABAAB stages each run snapshot OFF then 5000ms ON once with 1500000 measured requests. Keeps the complete parent plan, eight host-before records and all eight stage artifacts; only actual binaries and generated data are omitted. Every run met the declared coverage. Snapshot write-stage B/A ratios were lower in all four ON pairs, while end-to-end results were worse in three pairs; all slow runs including 03-B ON max 266.577726 ms are retained. These observations do not prove overall improvement or identify the cause of the regressions.

archives.name: snapshot-d2-bfed
archives.primary_observation: ON per-run snapshot write duration increment divided by complete snapshot count within common idle endpoints; derive adjacent paired B/A ratios only for adequate windows.

coverage_criteria.idle_window_selection: earliest and latest internal samples that are both snapshot_in_progress=false; no endpoint selection based on measured cost
coverage_criteria.coverage_failure_policy: continue the predeclared remaining sequence; preserve raw client results and mark affected phase metrics unavailable/coverage_insufficient. Stop only on experiment failure/interruption.
